records.literal_gloss: Gather yourselves together, and gather, nation not ashamed,

en.L: Gather yourselves together, yes, gather, \q O nation without shame,
en.B: Gather yourselves together, come together, \q you nation without shame,
en.R: Come together and gather in one place, \q you nation that has no shame.

fr.L: Rassemblez-vous, oui, rassemblez-vous, \q nation sans honte,
fr.R: Réunissez-vous, rassemblez-vous en un seul lieu, \q nation qui n’a pas de honte,

sw.L: Jikusanyeni pamoja, naam, kusanyikeni, \q ewe taifa lisilo na haya,
sw.B: Jikusanyeni pamoja, kusanyikeni, \q wewe taifa lisilo na aibu,

vi.L: Hãy nhóm lại với nhau, phải, hãy nhóm lại, \q hỡi dân tộc không biết xấu hổ,
vi.B: Hãy tụ họp lại, hãy cùng nhau nhóm lại, \q hỡi dân tộc chẳng biết hổ thẹn,

ko.L: 너희는 함께 모여라, 모여라. \q 부끄러움을 모르는 민족아.

ko.R: 너희는 한곳에 함께 모여라. \q 부끄러움을 모르는 민족아.

pt.L: Reúnam-se, sim, reúnam-se, \q ó nação que não sente vergonha,
pt.B: Reúnam-se, juntem-se, \q nação que não sente vergonha,
pt.R: Juntem-se e reúnam-se num só lugar, \q povo que não tem vergonha.

am.L: ተሰብሰቡ፤ አዎን፣ ተሰብሰቡ፤ \q እፍረት የሌለው ሕዝብ ሆይ፣
am.B: ተሰብሰቡ፤ በአንድነት ተከማቹ፤ \q እፍረት የሌለው ሕዝብ ሆይ፣
am.R: ኑ፣ በአንድ ስፍራ ተሰብሰቡ፤ \q እናንተ እፍረት የማታውቁ ሕዝብ።

hi.L: इकट्ठे हो जाओ, हाँ, इकट्ठे हो, \q हे निर्लज्ज जाति,
hi.B: इकट्ठे हो जाओ, एक साथ आओ, \q हे निर्लज्ज राष्ट्र,
hi.R: एक जगह इकट्ठे हो जाओ, \q हे राष्ट्र, जिसे कोई लज्जा नहीं।

ru.B: Соберитесь, сойдитесь вместе, \q народ, не знающий стыда,
ru.R: Соберитесь вместе в одном месте, \q народ, у которого нет стыда.

ja.L: 集まれ、寄り集まれ、 \q 恥を知らない国よ、
ja.B: 寄り集まりなさい、集まりなさい、 \q 恥を知らない国よ。
ja.R: 一か所に集まりなさい。 \q 恥を知らない国よ。

uk.L: Зберіться докупи, так, зберіться, \q народе без сорому,
uk.B: Зберіться докупи, сходьтеся, \q народе без сорому,
uk.R: Зійдіться й зберіться в одному місці, \q народе, що не має сорому,

decisions.choice: gather yourselves together: come together, perhaps "gather like stubble"
decisions.reason: The verb is used for gathering straw or stubble (Exodus 5:7, 12), and is related to the word for stubble. Doubling it gives urgency, and it may also hint at what the nation is: stubble, soon to be blown away like the chaff of verse 2. The sense of the call is plain: assemble, as for a fast or an assembly of repentance (Joel 2:15-16), before it is too late.

decisions.choice: nation without shame: a nation that feels no shame
decisions.reason: The verb usually means "long for" (Genesis 31:30; Psalm 84:3), which would give "a nation that is not desired" or "that has no longing". In later Hebrew and Aramaic a related word means "be pale" with shame, and that sense fits the call to humble themselves in verse 3.

decisions.choice: the nation: Judah
alternatives: the Philistines and the other nations named after
decisions.reason: The oracles against the nations begin in verse 4. The call here, and the call to seek the LORD in verse 3, are addressed to Judah, the people threatened in chapter 1, while there is still time. |

decisions.choice: without shame (L, B); that has no shame (R)
decisions.reason: The levels follow the meaning chosen in m2; the footnote gives the other. Readable ends the verse with a full stop and begins verse 2 with "Do it", to keep its sentences short. |

decisions.choice: "nation" addressed with "vous"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew verbs are plural: the people of Judah are addressed together, so French says "vous" though the vocative "nation" is singular, and no "ô" is added (the English Literal's "O" has no word in the Hebrew).

decisions.choice: plural_you on the imperatives
decisions.reason: The verbs are plural, addressed to the people of the nation, so they take the plural_you setting; the nation itself is named in the singular.

decisions.choice: the prophet addresses Judah as a group: "hỡi dân tộc", with plural commands
decisions.reason: The meaning decision: the nation is Judah; the prophet speaks to it in warning, with no pronoun for himself.

decisions.choice: nação que não sente vergonha (L, B); povo que não tem vergonha (R)
decisions.reason: The sense taken in m2 is said with a clause: Brazilian "sem-vergonha" is an everyday insult and would make the call sound like abuse rather than a warning. The call is plural, so Judah is addressed with "vocês" in verses 1-3.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans in the Amharic of this chapter
alternatives: deity_pronoun spans as in the English
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the deity_pronoun setting has nothing to change in Amharic; pronouns for God are written like any other.

decisions.choice: nation (goy, of Judah) "ሕዝብ" with plural verbs at every level
decisions.reason: "ሕዝቦች" is used for the other nations (2:11; 3:6, 8); Judah addressed as a nation is "ሕዝብ", as goy in Genesis on main.

decisions.choice: निर्लज्ज जाति (L); निर्लज्ज राष्ट्र (B); राष्ट्र, जिसे कोई लज्जा नहीं (R)
alternatives: जिस जाति को कोई चाह नहीं
decisions.reason: The levels follow the sense chosen in m2, a nation that feels no shame; the nation is Judah (m3). "Nation" follows the poetry note's rule: जाति at Literal, राष्ट्र at Balanced and Readable, since जाति also means caste.

decisions.choice: "бесстыдный" (L); "не знающий стыда" (B); "у которого нет стыда" (R)
decisions.reason: The levels follow the meaning chosen (m2), a nation that feels no shame; the English footnote gives the other reading.

decisions.choice: The call to Judah (2:1-3) uses the oracle commands "〜せよ" (L), "〜しなさい" (B, R), the people as plural "あなたがた" (L, B), "あなたたち" (R) in 2:2-3; hitqosheshu vaqoshu "集まれ、寄り集まれ" (L), the stubble pun not imitated.
decisions.reason: The prophetic conventions (ISA-ISA-1); the sense of the verb is uncertain (m1).

records.literal_gloss: before [the] decree gives birth (like chaff a day passes by), before there comes upon you [the] burning of [the] anger of Yahweh, before there comes upon you [the] day of [the] anger of Yahweh.

en.L: before the decree gives birth, \q like chaff the day passes by; \q before there comes upon you the burning anger of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q before there comes upon you the day of the anger of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: before the decree takes effect \q and the day blows away like chaff, \q before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s fierce anger falls on you, \q before the day of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s anger overtakes you.
en.R: Do it before what God has decided comes to pass, \q before your time blows away like chaff. \q Do it before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s fierce anger comes on you, \q before the day when {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} shows {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} anger.

fr.L: avant que le décret enfante, \q comme la paille le jour passe ; \q avant que vienne sur vous l’ardeur de la colère {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, \q avant que vienne sur vous le jour de la colère {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.B: avant que le décret ne s’accomplisse \q et que le jour ne s’envole comme la paille, \q avant que l’ardente colère {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ne tombe sur vous, \q avant que le jour de la colère {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ne vous surprenne.
fr.R: Faites-le avant que ce que Dieu a décidé arrive, \q avant que votre temps s’envole comme la paille. \q Faites-le avant que l’ardente colère {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} vienne sur vous, \q avant le jour où {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} montrera {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} colère.

es.L: antes que el decreto dé a luz, \q [como] paja pasa el día; \q antes que venga sobre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} el ardor de la ira {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, \q antes que venga sobre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} el día de la ira {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: antes que el decreto se cumpla \q y el día se lleve como paja, \q antes que caiga sobre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} el ardor de la ira {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, \q antes que {{plural_you:los|os}} alcance el día de la ira {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: {{plural_you:Háganlo|Hacedlo}} antes que se cumpla lo que Dios ha decidido, \q antes que {{plural_you:su tiempo|vuestro tiempo}} se vaya como la paja que se lleva el viento. \q {{plural_you:Háganlo|Hacedlo}} antes que el ardor de la ira {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} caiga sobre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, \q antes que llegue el día en que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} muestre {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} enojo.

sw.L: kabla amri haijazaa, \q siku inapita kama makapi; \q kabla hasira kali ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} haijawajia, \q kabla siku ya hasira ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} haijawajia.
sw.B: kabla amri haijatimizwa \q na siku kupeperushwa kama makapi, \q kabla hasira kali ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} haijawaangukia, \q kabla siku ya hasira ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} haijawapata.
sw.R: Fanyeni hivyo kabla yale ambayo Mungu ameamua hayajatimia, \q kabla wakati wenu haujapeperushwa kama makapi. \q Fanyeni hivyo kabla hasira kali ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} haijawajia, \q kabla ya siku ile {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakapoonyesha hasira {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.

vi.L: trước khi sắc lệnh sinh ra, \q ngày ấy trôi qua như trấu; \q trước khi cơn giận phừng phừng của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đến trên các ngươi, \q trước khi ngày thịnh nộ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đến trên các ngươi.
vi.B: trước khi sắc lệnh được thi hành \q và thời giờ bay đi như trấu, \q trước khi cơn giận dữ dội của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} giáng trên các ngươi, \q trước khi ngày thịnh nộ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ập đến trên các ngươi.
vi.R: Hãy làm điều đó trước khi điều Đức Chúa Trời đã định xảy ra, \q trước khi thời giờ của các ngươi bay mất như trấu. \q Hãy làm điều đó trước khi cơn giận dữ dội của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đổ trên các ngươi, \q trước khi đến ngày {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tỏ cơn giận của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 작정한 일이 [실행되어] 태어나기 전에, \q 그날이 겨처럼 지나가기 전에, \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 맹렬한 진노가 너희에게 닥치기 전에, \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 진노의 날이 너희에게 닥치기 전에 [모여라].
ko.B: 정해진 일이 이루어지기 전에, \q 그날이 겨처럼 날아가 버리기 전에, \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 맹렬한 진노가 너희에게 쏟아지기 전에, \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 진노하시는 날이 너희에게 닥치기 전에 모여라.
ko.R: 하나님께서 정하신 일이 이루어지기 전에 그렇게 하여라. \q 너희에게 남은 시간이 겨처럼 날아가 버리기 전에 그렇게 하여라. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 무서운 분노가 너희에게 닥치기 전에 그렇게 하여라. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 분노를 쏟으시는 날이 오기 전에 그렇게 하여라.

pt.L: antes que o decreto dê à luz, \q como palha o dia passa; \q antes que venha sobre vocês o ardor da ira {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, \q antes que venha sobre vocês o dia da ira {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.B: antes que o decreto se cumpra \q e o dia se vá como palha levada pelo vento, \q antes que caia sobre vocês a ira ardente {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, \q antes que os alcance o dia da ira {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.R: Façam isso antes que aconteça o que Deus decidiu, \q antes que o tempo de vocês seja levado como palha pelo vento. \q Façam isso antes que a ira ardente {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} caia sobre vocês, \q antes que chegue o dia em que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} vai mostrar a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} ira.

am.L: ትእዛዙ ሳይወልድ፣ \q ቀኑ እንደ ገለባ ያልፋል፤ \q {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} የሚነድድ ቁጣ በእናንተ ላይ ሳይመጣ፣ \q {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} የቁጣ ቀን በእናንተ ላይ ሳይመጣ።
am.B: ትእዛዙ ሳይፈጸም፣ \q ቀኑም እንደ ገለባ በነፋስ ሳይበን፣ \q {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ጽኑ ቁጣ ሳይወርድባችሁ፣ \q {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} የቁጣ ቀን ሳይደርስባችሁ።
am.R: እግዚአብሔር የወሰነው ነገር ከመፈጸሙ በፊት ይህን አድርጉ፤ \q ጊዜያችሁ እንደ ገለባ በነፋስ ከመበተኑ በፊት። \q {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ጽኑ ቁጣ ከመምጣቱ በፊት ይህን አድርጉ፤ \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ቁጣውን ከሚገልጥበት ቀን በፊት።

hi.L: इससे पहले कि आज्ञा जन्म दे, \q दिन भूसी के समान उड़ जाता है; \q इससे पहले कि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का भड़का हुआ क्रोध तुम पर आ पड़े, \q इससे पहले कि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के क्रोध का दिन तुम पर आ पड़े।
hi.B: इससे पहले कि आज्ञा पूरी हो जाए \q और दिन भूसी के समान उड़ जाए, \q इससे पहले कि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का भड़का हुआ क्रोध तुम पर टूट पड़े, \q इससे पहले कि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के क्रोध का दिन तुम्हें आ घेरे।
hi.R: ऐसा उससे पहले करो कि परमेश्वर ने जो ठान लिया है, वह पूरा हो जाए, \q और तुम्हारा समय भूसी की तरह उड़ जाए। \q ऐसा उससे पहले करो कि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का भयंकर क्रोध तुम पर आ पड़े, \q उस दिन से पहले जब {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपना क्रोध दिखाएँगे।

ru.L: прежде чем родит определение — \q как мякина проходит день; \q прежде чем придёт на вас пылающий гнев {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, \q прежде чем придёт на вас день гнева {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.
ru.B: пока не исполнилось решённое \q и день не унёсся, как мякина, \q пока не обрушился на вас пылающий гнев {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, \q пока не настиг вас день гнева {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.
ru.R: Сделайте это, пока не исполнилось то, что решил Бог, \q пока ваше время не унеслось, как мякина. \q Сделайте это, пока на вас не обрушился пылающий гнев {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, \q пока не пришёл день, когда {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} покажет свой гнев.

ja.L: 定めが生み出される前に、 \q もみ殻のように、その日は過ぎ去る。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の燃える怒りがあなたがたに臨む前に、 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の怒りの日があなたがたに臨む前に。
ja.B: 定めが実行に移され、 \q その日がもみ殻のように吹き飛ばされる前に、 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の激しく燃える怒りがあなたがたに下る前に、 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の怒りの日があなたがたに襲いかかる前に。
ja.R: 神が決められたことが起こる前に、そうしなさい。 \q あなたたちの時が、もみ殻のように吹き飛ばされる前に。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の激しい怒りがあなたたちに下る前に、そうしなさい。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が怒りを示される日が来る前に。

uk.L: перш ніж постанова народить, \q як полова, минає день; \q перш ніж прийде на вас палючий гнів {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, \q перш ніж прийде на вас день гніву {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}.
uk.B: перш ніж постанова здійсниться \q і день розвіється, як полова, \q перш ніж палючий гнів {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} впаде на вас, \q перш ніж наздожене вас день гніву {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}.
uk.R: Зробіть це, поки не здійснилося те, що вирішив Бог, \q поки ваш час не розвіявся, як полова. \q Зробіть це, поки на вас не прийшов лютий гнів {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, \q поки не настав день, коли {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} виявить свій гнів.

decisions.choice: before the decree gives birth, like chaff the day passes by: before God's decision is carried out and the time runs out
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is hard and reads like a broken line. "Gives birth" pictures the decree of judgment bringing forth what it holds, as a pregnant woman gives birth. "Like chaff the day passes" seems to mean that the time left is being blown away as chaff is blown off the threshing floor. The ancient translations read the line in different ways, and some suggest small changes to the text; the sense of urgency is clear either way.

decisions.choice: the burning of the anger of the LORD: his fierce anger
decisions.reason: Anger in Hebrew is "heat of the nose", and "burning" makes it stronger still. The phrase is common (Jeremiah 4:8; Nahum 1:6). |

decisions.choice: three times "before": the call is urgent
decisions.reason: The verse repeats "before" three times, each time nearer to the day itself. The call to gather in verse 1 and to seek the LORD in verse 3 must be answered before the day comes. |

decisions.choice: takes effect (B); comes to pass (R); gives birth (L)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the picture of birth. Balanced and Readable say what it means (m1). Readable names God as the one who decided, which the verse implies. |

decisions.choice: "the burning anger of the LORD" is "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 맹렬한 진노" (L, B) and "무서운 분노" (R)
decisions.reason: The term sheet's wording for wrath ("진노" L, B; "분노" R). The prophet speaks of God here, so "진노하시는" takes -시-.

decisions.choice: the day of the anger of the LORD "የእግዚአብሔር የቁጣ ቀን" (L, B), as Lamentations 2:22; R "እግዚአብሔር ቁጣውን የሚገልጥበት ቀን", as Ezekiel 7:19 R; the same in 2:3
decisions.reason: One wording for the phrase through Zephaniah (1:18; 2:2, 3), matching its use on main.

decisions.choice: जन्म दे (L); पूरी हो जाए (B); जो ठान लिया है, वह पूरा हो जाए (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the picture of the decree giving birth; Balanced and Readable say what it means (m1). The Readable form of "the day of the LORD's anger" (जिस दिन / जब {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपना क्रोध दिखाएँगे) follows 1:18 and Ezekiel 7:19, and is used through the chapter.

decisions.choice: "прежде чем родит определение" (L); "пока не исполнилось решённое" (B); "пока не исполнилось то, что решил Бог" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the picture of birth; Balanced and Readable say what it means (m1), as the English levels do.

decisions.choice: teled choq "定めが生み出される" (L), "定めが実行に移され" (B), "神が決められたことが起こる" (R); charon 'af "燃える怒り" (L), "激しく燃える怒り" (B), "激しい怒り" (R) as Jonah 3:9; the three "前に" kept at every level.
decisions.reason: The opening lines are textually uncertain (m1, footnoted); the threefold 'before' is the urgency of the call (m3).

source.text: בַּקְּשׁ֤וּ אֶת־יְהוָה֙ כָּל־עַנְוֵ֣י הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר מִשְׁפָּט֖וֹ פָּעָ֑לוּ בַּקְּשׁוּ־צֶ֨דֶק֙ בַּקְּשׁ֣וּ עֲנָוָ֔ה אוּלַי֙ תִּסָּ֣תְר֔וּ בְּי֖וֹם אַף־יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Seek Yahweh, all [the] humble of the land who have done his justice; seek righteousness, seek humility; perhaps you will be hidden on [the] day of [the] anger of Yahweh.

en.L: Seek {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, all you humble of the land, \q who have done {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} justice; \q seek righteousness, seek humility; \q perhaps you will be hidden \q on the day of the anger of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Seek {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, all you humble people of the land, \q you who carry out {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} commands. \q Seek righteousness; seek humility. \q It may be that you will find shelter \q on the day of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s anger.
en.R: Turn to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, all you humble people of the land, \q you who obey {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} laws. \q Try hard to do what is right and to be humble. \q Then perhaps you will be kept safe \q on the day when {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} shows {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} anger.

fr.L: Cherchez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, vous tous, humbles du pays, \q qui avez pratiqué {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} droit ; \q cherchez la justice, cherchez l’humilité ; \q peut-être serez-vous cachés \q au jour de la colère {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Cherchez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, vous tous, les humbles du pays, \q vous qui mettez en pratique {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} commandements. \q Recherchez la justice ; recherchez l’humilité. \q Peut-être trouverez-vous un abri \q au jour de la colère {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Tournez-vous vers {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, vous tous, les humbles du pays, \q vous qui obéissez à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} lois. \q Efforcez-vous de faire ce qui est juste et d’être humbles. \q Alors peut-être serez-vous protégés \q le jour où {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} montrera {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} colère.

es.L: {{plural_you:Busquen|Buscad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, todos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, los humildes de la tierra, \q que han practicado {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} derecho; \q {{plural_you:busquen|buscad}} la justicia, {{plural_you:busquen|buscad}} la humildad; \q quizás {{plural_you:serán escondidos|seréis escondidos}} \q en el día de la ira {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: {{plural_you:Busquen|Buscad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, todos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, gente humilde de la tierra, \q {{plural_you:ustedes que cumplen|vosotros que cumplís}} {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} mandatos. \q {{plural_you:Busquen|Buscad}} la justicia; {{plural_you:busquen|buscad}} la humildad. \q Tal vez así {{plural_you:encuentren|encontréis}} refugio \q en el día de la ira {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: {{plural_you:Vuélvanse|Volveos}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, todos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, gente humilde de la tierra, \q {{plural_you:ustedes que obedecen|vosotros que obedecéis}} {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} leyes. \q {{plural_you:Esfuércense|Esforzaos}} por hacer lo que es correcto y por ser humildes. \q Entonces tal vez {{plural_you:estarán|estaréis}} a salvo \q el día en que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} muestre {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} enojo.

sw.L: Mtafuteni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ninyi nyote wanyenyekevu wa nchi, \q mliotenda hukumu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}; \q tafuteni haki, tafuteni unyenyekevu; \q huenda mtafichwa \q katika siku ya hasira ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Mtafuteni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ninyi nyote wanyenyekevu wa nchi, \q ninyi mnaotekeleza maagizo {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. \q Tafuteni haki; tafuteni unyenyekevu. \q Huenda mkapata hifadhi \q katika siku ya hasira ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Mrudieni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ninyi nyote wanyenyekevu wa nchi, \q ninyi mnaotii sheria {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}. \q Jitahidini kutenda yaliyo haki na kuwa wanyenyekevu. \q Huenda mtalindwa salama \q siku ile {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakapoonyesha hasira {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.

vi.L: Hãy tìm kiếm {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, hỡi tất cả những người khiêm nhu của xứ, \q là những người đã làm theo công lý của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q hãy tìm kiếm sự công chính, hãy tìm kiếm sự khiêm nhu; \q có lẽ các ngươi sẽ được che giấu \q trong ngày thịnh nộ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Hỡi tất cả những người khiêm nhu trong xứ, \q là những người làm theo mạng lệnh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, hãy tìm kiếm {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. \q Hãy tìm kiếm sự công chính; hãy tìm kiếm sự khiêm nhu. \q Biết đâu các ngươi sẽ được che chở \q trong ngày thịnh nộ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Hỡi tất cả những người khiêm nhường trong xứ, \q là những người vâng giữ luật lệ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, hãy quay về với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. \q Hãy cố gắng làm điều ngay thẳng và sống khiêm nhường. \q Biết đâu các ngươi sẽ được giữ an toàn \q trong ngày {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tỏ cơn giận của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그분의 법도를 행하는 이 땅의 모든 겸손한 자들아, \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찾아라. \q 의를 찾고 겸손을 찾아라. \q 혹시 너희가 \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 진노의 날에 숨겨질지도 모른다.
ko.B: 그분의 명령을 지키는 이 땅의 모든 겸손한 사람들아, \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찾아라. \q 의를 구하고 겸손을 구하여라. \q 그러면 혹시 너희가 \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 진노하시는 날에 보호를 받을지도 모른다.
ko.R: 이 땅에서 겸손하게 살며 그분의 법을 지키는 사람들아, \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 돌아오너라. \q 옳은 일을 하고 겸손하게 살려고 힘써라. \q 그러면 혹시 너희가 \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 분노를 쏟으시는 날에 안전할지도 모른다.

pt.L: Busquem {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, todos vocês, humildes da terra, \q que praticaram a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} justiça; \q busquem a retidão, busquem a humildade; \q talvez vocês sejam escondidos \q no dia da ira {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.B: Busquem {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, todos vocês, os humildes da terra, \q vocês que cumprem os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} mandamentos. \q Busquem a retidão; busquem a humildade. \q Pode ser que vocês encontrem abrigo \q no dia da ira {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.R: Voltem-se para {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, todos vocês, pessoas humildes da terra, \q vocês que obedecem às {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} leis. \q Esforcem-se para fazer o que é certo e para ser humildes. \q Então talvez vocês fiquem protegidos \q no dia em que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} mostrar a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} ira.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ፈልጉ፣ እናንተ የምድሪቱ ትሑታን ሁሉ፣ \q ፍርዱን የፈጸማችሁ፤ \q ጽድቅን ፈልጉ፤ ትሕትናን ፈልጉ፤ \q ምናልባት ትሸሸጉ ይሆናል \q {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} የቁጣ ቀን።
am.B: እናንተ በምድሪቱ ያላችሁ ትሑታን ሁሉ፣ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ፈልጉ፤ \q ትእዛዙን የምትፈጽሙ እናንተ። \q ጽድቅን ፈልጉ፤ ትሕትናን ፈልጉ። \q ምናልባት መጠጊያ ታገኙ ይሆናል \q {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} የቁጣ ቀን።
am.R: እናንተ በምድሪቱ የምትኖሩ ትሑታን ሁሉ፣ ወደ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ቅረቡ፤ \q ሕጉን የምትጠብቁ እናንተ። \q ትክክል የሆነውን ለማድረግና ትሑት ለመሆን ተጣጣሩ። \q ያን ጊዜ ምናልባት በሰላም ትጠበቁ ይሆናል \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ቁጣውን በሚገልጥበት ቀን።

hi.L: हे देश के सब नम्र लोगो, \q जिन्होंने उनके नियमों का पालन किया है, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को खोजो; \q धार्मिकता को खोजो, नम्रता को खोजो; \q कदाचित तुम \q {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के क्रोध के दिन छिपाए जाओ।
hi.B: हे देश के सब नम्र लोगो, \q तुम जो उनकी आज्ञाओं पर चलते हो, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को खोजो। \q धार्मिकता को खोजो, नम्रता को खोजो। \q हो सकता है कि तुम्हें शरण मिले \q {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के क्रोध के दिन।
hi.R: हे देश के सब नम्र लोगो, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की ओर फिरो, \q तुम जो उनके नियमों को मानते हो। \q जो सही है, वह करने और नम्र बनने का पूरा यत्न करो। \q तब हो सकता है कि तुम सुरक्षित रखे जाओ \q उस दिन, जब {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपना क्रोध दिखाएँगे।

ru.L: Ищите {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, все смиренные земли, \q исполнявшие {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} суд; \q ищите праведности, ищите смирения; \q может быть, вы будете укрыты \q в день гнева {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.
ru.B: Ищите {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, все смиренные люди земли, \q вы, исполняющие {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} повеления. \q Ищите праведности, ищите смирения. \q Может быть, вы найдёте укрытие \q в день гнева {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.
ru.R: Обратитесь к {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, все смиренные люди страны, \q вы, кто исполняет {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} законы. \q Старайтесь жить правильно и быть смиренными. \q Тогда, может быть, вы останетесь в безопасности \q в тот день, когда {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} покажет свой гнев.

ja.L: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}を求めよ、地のすべてのへりくだる者たちよ、 \q その方の公正を行ってきた者たちよ。 \q 正義を求めよ。へりくだりを求めよ。 \q そうすれば、あなたがたは隠されるかもしれない、 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の怒りの日に。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}を求めなさい、この地のへりくだる人々よ、 \q その方の定めを行う者たちよ。 \q 正義を求め、謙遜を求めなさい。 \q そうすれば、あなたがたは守られるかもしれない、 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の怒りの日に。
ja.R: この地のへりくだった人々よ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}を求めなさい。 \q その方のおきてを守る人々よ。 \q 正しいことを行い、へりくだるように努めなさい。 \q そうすれば、守られるかもしれない。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が怒りを示される日に。

uk.L: Шукайте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, усі покірні землі, \q що виконували {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} правосуддя; \q шукайте праведності, шукайте покори; \q може, ви будете сховані \q в день гніву {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}.
uk.B: Шукайте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, усі покірні люди землі, \q ви, що виконуєте {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} накази. \q Шукайте праведності; шукайте покори. \q Може, ви знайдете притулок \q у день гніву {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}.
uk.R: Наверніться до {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, усі покірні люди землі, \q ви, що слухаєтеся {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} законів. \q Щосили намагайтеся чинити правильно й бути покірними. \q Тоді, може, ви вціліте \q в день, коли {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} виявить свій гнів.

decisions.choice: the humble of the land: the lowly, who depend on God
decisions.reason: The word means the poor and lowly, and often those who, having no power of their own, look to God (Isaiah 11:4; Psalm 37:11; Amos 2:7). In 3:12 the LORD promises to leave in Jerusalem "a people humble and lowly". Jesus' blessing on the meek who will inherit the earth (Matthew 5:5) takes up Psalm 37:11. |

decisions.choice: who have done his justice: who keep his commands
decisions.reason: "His justice" is what he has decided is right, his rulings and laws (Jeremiah 5:4-5; 8:7). Those who do it live by his law. Even they are told to go on seeking. |

decisions.choice: perhaps you will be hidden: perhaps the LORD will shelter you
decisions.reason: "Perhaps" leaves the rescue in God's hands, as in Joel 2:14 ("Who knows? He may turn") and Amos 5:15. Being hidden means being kept safe in time of danger (Psalm 27:5). There is a play on the prophet's name, Zephaniah, which means "the LORD has hidden" or "the LORD protects". |

decisions.choice: righteousness (L, B); to do what is right (R); his commands (B), his laws (R)
decisions.reason: Righteousness here is right living as God requires. Readable says "what is right", as the Amos table does. Balanced and Readable say "commands" and "laws" for "his justice" (m2). Readable says "Turn to" for "Seek", as elsewhere in the prophets. |

decisions.choice: "su derecho" (L), "sus mandatos" (B), "sus leyes" (R); "la justicia" (L, B), "lo que es correcto" (R)
decisions.reason: Mishpat is "derecho" at L, as the prophets' word pair; B and R say what doing it means. Tsedeq is "justicia" at L and B and "lo que es correcto" at R, as the term sheet sets.

decisions.choice: Korean puts the vocative with its relative clause first and the command "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찾아라" after it
decisions.reason: A Korean relative clause must stand before its noun, so "all you humble of the land, who have done his justice" can only come as one block; the line break still divides the two Hebrew parts.

decisions.choice: *mishpat* here is "법도" (L), "명령" (B) and "법" (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads "his justice" as his commands kept by the humble; the English has "commands" and "laws".

decisions.choice: a retidão (L, B), o que é certo (R); talvez (L, R), Pode ser que (B)
decisions.reason: Tsedeq is "retidão", as the Twelve set it beside mishpat "justiça"; Readable says "o que é certo", as the English does. "Talvez" and "Pode ser que" leave the rescue in God's hands (m3), as Amos 5:15 says it in Portuguese at each level. The play on Zephaniah's name, "the LORD has hidden", is left to the meaning note.

decisions.choice: the humble of the land "የምድሪቱ ትሑታን"; perhaps you will be hidden "ምናልባት ትሸሸጉ ይሆናል" (L), "መጠጊያ ታገኙ" (B), "በሰላም ትጠበቁ" (R)
decisions.reason: "ትሸሸጉ" keeps the picture of being hidden from the storm without the familiar wording of the 1962 Bible.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans
decisions.reason: Devanagari has no capital letters, so the English deity_pronoun spans have no Hindi counterpart; God spoken of takes the honorific plural (उनके) at every level.

decisions.choice: उनके नियमों का पालन किया है (L), उनकी आज्ञाओं पर चलते हो (B), उनके नियमों को मानते हो (R); धार्मिकता (L, B), जो सही है (R)
decisions.reason: "Who have done his justice" means who keep his commands (m2); Literal says नियम so that it is not read as judging. Righteousness is धार्मिकता, as the style guide's key term; Readable says what it is in conduct, as the English does. Literal's line order follows Hindi, which puts the vocative and its clause before the verb.

decisions.choice: "праведности" (L, B); "жить правильно" (R); "суд" (L), "повеления" (B), "законы" (R)
decisions.reason: Righteousness here is right living, so Readable says "жить правильно", as the style guide allows; Literal keeps "суд" for mishpat and the other levels say what doing it means (m2).

decisions.choice: biqqesh "求めよ" (L), "求めなさい" (B, R); 'anwei ha'arets "地のへりくだる者たち" (L), "この地のへりくだる人々" (B), "へりくだった人々" (R); mishpato "その方の公正" (L), "その方の定め" (B), "その方のおきて" (R); tsedeq "正義" (L, B), "正しいこと" (R); 'anawah "へりくだり" (L), "謙遜" (B).
decisions.reason: 'anaw as Amos 2:7 (へりくだる者たち); tsedeq in the social sense "正義" (ISA-ISA-1); B and R give mishpat as 'his commands / laws' as the English does (m2).

decisions.choice: 'ulai tissatru "隠されるかもしれない" (L), "守られるかもしれない" (B, R).
decisions.reason: To be hidden is to be sheltered by the LORD (m3).

source.text: כִּ֤י עַזָּה֙ עֲזוּבָ֣ה תִֽהְיֶ֔ה וְאַשְׁקְל֖וֹן לִשְׁמָמָ֑ה אַשְׁדּ֗וֹד בַּֽצָּהֳרַ֨יִם֙ יְגָ֣רְשׁ֔וּהָ וְעֶקְר֖וֹן תֵּעָקֵֽר׃ס

records.literal_gloss: For Gaza will be abandoned, and Ashkelon [will become] a desolation; Ashdod, at noon they will drive her out, and Ekron will be uprooted.

en.L: For Gaza will be abandoned, \q and Ashkelon [will become] a desolation; \q Ashdod they will drive out at noon, \q and Ekron will be uprooted.
en.B: For Gaza will be deserted \q and Ashkelon left in ruins; \q Ashdod's people will be driven out at noon, \q and Ekron will be torn up by the roots.
en.R: Gaza will be left empty, \q and Ashkelon will be destroyed. \q The people of Ashdod will be driven out in the middle of the day, \q and Ekron will be pulled up by its roots.

fr.L: Car Gaza sera abandonnée, \q et Ashqelôn [deviendra] une désolation ; \q Ashdod, à midi on la chassera, \q et Eqrôn sera déracinée.
fr.B: Car Gaza sera délaissée \q et Ashqelôn laissée en ruines ; \q les habitants d’Ashdod seront chassés en plein midi, \q et Eqrôn sera arrachée jusqu’aux racines.
fr.R: Gaza sera vidée de ses habitants, \q et Ashqelôn sera détruite. \q Les habitants d’Ashdod seront chassés au milieu de la journée, \q et Eqrôn sera arrachée avec ses racines.

es.L: Porque Gaza será abandonada, \q y Ascalón [será] una desolación; \q a Asdod la expulsarán al mediodía, \q y Ecrón será desarraigada.
es.B: Porque Gaza quedará desierta \q y Ascalón en ruinas; \q la gente de Asdod será expulsada al mediodía, \q y Ecrón será arrancada de raíz.
es.R: Gaza quedará vacía, \q y Ascalón será destruida. \q La gente de Asdod será expulsada en pleno día, \q y Ecrón será arrancada de raíz.

sw.L: Kwa maana Gaza utaachwa, \q na Ashkeloni [utakuwa] ukiwa; \q Ashdodi watawafukuza adhuhuri, \q na Ekroni utang'olewa.
sw.B: Kwa maana Gaza utaachwa mtupu \q na Ashkeloni utaachwa magofu; \q watu wa Ashdodi watafukuzwa adhuhuri, \q na Ekroni utang'olewa pamoja na mizizi yake.
sw.R: Gaza utaachwa bila watu, \q na Ashkeloni utaharibiwa. \q Watu wa Ashdodi watafukuzwa mchana kweupe, \q na Ekroni utang'olewa kama mti pamoja na mizizi yake.

vi.L: Vì Ga-xa sẽ bị bỏ hoang, \q và Ách-ca-lôn [sẽ thành] hoang vu; \q Ách-đốt, người ta sẽ đuổi nó đi lúc giữa trưa, \q và Éc-rôn sẽ bị nhổ rễ.
vi.B: Vì Ga-xa sẽ bị bỏ hoang, \q Ách-ca-lôn sẽ thành đống đổ nát; \q dân Ách-đốt sẽ bị đuổi đi giữa ban trưa, \q và Éc-rôn sẽ bị nhổ tận gốc.
vi.R: Ga-xa sẽ bị bỏ trống, \q và Ách-ca-lôn sẽ bị phá hủy. \q Dân Ách-đốt sẽ bị đuổi đi giữa ban ngày, \q và Éc-rôn sẽ bị nhổ tận rễ.

ko.L: 가사가 버림받고, \q 아스글론이 황폐해질 것이다. \q 아스돗은 대낮에 그들이 쫓아낼 것이고, \q 에그론은 뿌리째 뽑힐 것이다.
ko.B: 가사는 버려지고 \q 아스글론은 폐허가 될 것이다. \q 아스돗 사람들은 대낮에 쫓겨나고, \q 에그론은 뿌리째 뽑힐 것이다.
ko.R: 가사는 텅 빈 곳이 되고, \q 아스글론은 무너질 것이다. \q 아스돗 사람들은 한낮에 쫓겨나고, \q 에그론은 뿌리째 뽑혀 버릴 것이다.

pt.L: Porque Gaza será abandonada, \q e Asquelom [se tornará] uma desolação; \q Asdode, ao meio-dia a expulsarão, \q e Ecrom será desarraigada.
pt.B: Gaza ficará deserta, \q e Asquelom, em ruínas; \q o povo de Asdode será expulso ao meio-dia, \q e Ecrom será arrancada pela raiz.
pt.R: Gaza vai ficar vazia, \q e Asquelom vai ser destruída. \q O povo de Asdode vai ser expulso no meio do dia, \q e Ecrom vai ser arrancada pela raiz.

am.L: ጋዛ የተተወች ትሆናለችና፤ \q አስቀሎንም ባድማ [ትሆናለች]፤ \q አዛጦንን በቀትር ያባርሯታል፤ \q አቃሮንም ትነቀላለች።
am.B: ጋዛ ባዶዋን ትቀራለችና፤ \q አስቀሎንም ፈራርሳ ትቀራለች፤ \q የአዛጦን ሕዝብ በቀትር ይባረራል፤ \q አቃሮንም ከሥሯ ትነቀላለች።
am.R: ጋዛ ባዶዋን ትቀራለች፤ \q አስቀሎንም ትጠፋለች። \q የአዛጦን ሰዎች በእኩለ ቀን ይባረራሉ፤ \q አቃሮንም ከሥሯ ትነቀላለች።

hi.L: क्योंकि गाज़ा त्याग दिया जाएगा, \q और अश्कलोन उजाड़ [हो जाएगा]; \q अशदोद को वे दोपहर ही को निकाल देंगे, \q और एक्रोन उखाड़ा जाएगा।
hi.B: क्योंकि गाज़ा सुनसान छोड़ दिया जाएगा \q और अश्कलोन खंडहर बन जाएगा; \q अशदोद के लोग भरी दोपहरी में निकाल दिए जाएँगे, \q और एक्रोन जड़ से उखाड़ दिया जाएगा।
hi.R: गाज़ा ख़ाली छोड़ दिया जाएगा, \q और अश्कलोन नष्ट कर दिया जाएगा। \q अशदोद के लोग दिन-दहाड़े निकाल दिए जाएँगे, \q और एक्रोन को जड़ से उखाड़ दिया जाएगा।

ru.L: Ведь Газа будет оставлена, \q и Аскалон [станет] запустением; \q Азот в полдень изгонят, \q и Аккарон будет искоренён.
ru.B: Ведь Газа опустеет, \q Аскалон останется в развалинах, \q жителей Азота изгонят в полдень, \q и Аккарон будет вырван с корнем.
ru.R: Газа останется пустой, \q и Аскалон будет разрушен. \q Жителей Азота выгонят среди бела дня, \q и Аккарон вырвут с корнем.

ja.L: まことに、ガザは捨てられ、 \q アシュケロンは荒れ果てる。 \q アシュドドは、真昼に人々が追い出し、 \q エクロンは根こそぎにされる。
ja.B: ガザは見捨てられ、 \q アシュケロンは廃墟となる。 \q アシュドドの民は真昼に追い出され、 \q エクロンは根こそぎ引き抜かれる。
ja.R: ガザは人のいない町となり、 \q アシュケロンは滅ぼされる。 \q アシュドドの人々は、真昼に追い出され、 \q エクロンは根こそぎにされる。

uk.L: Бо Газа буде покинута, \q і Ашкелон [стане] пусткою; \q Ашдод опівдні виженуть, \q і Екрон буде викорчуваний.
uk.B: Бо Газа спустіє, \q а Ашкелон залишиться в руїнах; \q людей Ашдоду виженуть опівдні, \q а Екрон вирвуть з корінням.
uk.R: Газа залишиться порожньою, \q а Ашкелон буде зруйнований. \q Людей Ашдоду виженуть серед білого дня, \q а Екрон вирвуть з корінням.

decisions.choice: Gaza abandoned, Ekron uprooted: plays on the names
decisions.reason: In Hebrew, "Gaza" ('azzah) and "abandoned" ('azuvah) sound alike, and so do "Ekron" ('eqron) and "uprooted" (te'aqer). Each city's name foretells its fate. The play cannot be kept in translation.

decisions.choice: Gaza, Ashkelon, Ashdod, Ekron: four of the five cities of the Philistines
decisions.reason: The Philistines lived on the coastal plain west of Judah, in five chief cities (Joshua 13:3). Gath, the fifth, is missing here, as in Amos 1:6-8 and Jeremiah 25:20; it may have lost its importance by then. |

decisions.choice: at noon: suddenly, in broad daylight
decisions.reason: Armies usually attacked at dawn. An attack at noon, during the hot hour of rest, would come when no one expected it (Jeremiah 6:4; 15:8). It may also mean that the city falls in half a day.

decisions.choice: in the middle of the day (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says "in the middle of the day" for "at noon". |

decisions.choice: "Gaza … abandonnée", "Eqrôn … déracinée"; the Philistine cities as the term sheet (Gaza, Ashqelôn, Ashdod, Eqrôn), feminine
decisions.reason: French cannot keep the plays on the names (footnoted in the meaning decision); the verbs are chosen for their sense. The cities take feminine agreement, as French place names of cities usually do.

decisions.choice: "Gaza ... abandonada", "Ecrón ... desarraigada" / "arrancada de raíz"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew plays on the names (Azzah / azuvah, Eqron / te'aqer); Spanish cannot keep the sound, and the meaning decision explains it. The city names are the published forms.

decisions.choice: "Gaza ... utaachwa", "Ekroni utang'olewa"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew plays on the names (Gaza / abandoned, Ekron / uprooted); Swahili cannot keep the sound play and translates the sense, leaving the play to the footnote. Gaza, Ashkeloni, Ashdodi and Ekroni are the published forms.

decisions.choice: The Philistine cities are "가사", "아스글론", "아스돗", "에그론"; the Hebrew plays on Gaza and Ekron (*'azzah 'azuvah*, *'eqron te'aqer*) cannot be kept
alternatives: imitating the puns with Korean sound-alikes
decisions.reason: The names are spelled as published (the term sheet; 1 Samuel). The wordplay is explained in the shared meaning decision and its footnote.

decisions.choice: Gaza, Asquelom, Asdode, Ecrom
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the Philistine cities (m2) keep the forms Isaiah, Jeremiah and Amos 1:6-8 give them in Portuguese. The plays on Gaza and Ekron (m1) cannot be kept.

decisions.choice: Gaza, Ashkelon, Ashdod, Ekron as "ጋዛ፣ አስቀሎን፣ አዛጦን፣ አቃሮን" (Amos 1:6-8; Jeremiah 25:20); the plays on Gaza and Ekron are not reproduced
decisions.reason: Names keep their forms on main; Amharic has no verbs that sound like the names, and the meaning decision explains the play.

decisions.choice: Газа, Ашкелон, Ашдод, Екрон; керетяни (verse 5); Моав and аммонітяни; Куш, кушити
decisions.reason: The established Ukrainian Bible forms of the names, with Gaza in its modern spelling; the plays on the names in the Hebrew are explained in the meaning decision and are not imitated.

decisions.choice: गाज़ा, अश्कलोन, अशदोद, एक्रोन
decisions.reason: The four Philistine cities (m2) keep the forms of Joshua, Samuel and Acts 8:26 in this translation. The plays on Gaza and Ekron (m1) cannot be kept in Hindi.

decisions.choice: Газа, Аскалон, Азот, Аккарон
decisions.reason: The traditional forms already used for the Philistine cities in Joshua, 1 Samuel and Jeremiah 25:20 in Russian. The Hebrew plays on the names (m1); the play cannot be kept in Russian.

decisions.choice: Gaza "ガザ", Ashkelon "アシュケロン", Ashdod "アシュドド", Ekron "エクロン" (Amos 1:6-8); the plays on 'Gaza / abandoned' and 'Ekron / uprooted' are not imitated (footnote m1).
decisions.reason: Names as AMO-AMO-1.

source.text: ה֗וֹי יֹֽשְׁבֵ֛י חֶ֥בֶל הַיָּ֖ם גּ֣וֹי כְּרֵתִ֑ים דְּבַר־יְהוָ֣ה עֲלֵיכֶ֗ם כְּנַ֨עַן֙ אֶ֣רֶץ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וְהַאֲבַדְתִּ֖יךְ מֵאֵ֥ין יוֹשֵֽׁב׃

records.literal_gloss: Woe [to the] inhabitants of the region of the sea, [the] nation of [the] Cherethites! [The] word of Yahweh [is] against you, Canaan, land of [the] Philistines, and I will destroy you until there is no inhabitant.

en.L: Woe, inhabitants of the seacoast, nation of Cherethites! \q The word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is against you, Canaan, land of the Philistines; \q and I will destroy you until no inhabitant [is left].
en.B: Woe to you who live by the sea, you nation of Cherethites! \q The word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is against you, Canaan, land of the Philistines: \q I will destroy you until no one is left.
en.R: How terrible it will be for you who live along the sea, you Cherethites! \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has spoken against you, Canaan, land of the Philistines: \q I will destroy you until no one is left.

fr.L: Malheur, habitants du littoral, nation des Kéréthiens ! \q La parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} est contre vous, Canaan, pays des Philistins ; \q et je te détruirai jusqu’à ce qu’il n’y ait plus d’habitant.
fr.B: Malheur à vous qui habitez au bord de la mer, nation des Kéréthiens ! \q La parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} est contre vous, Canaan, pays des Philistins : \q je te détruirai jusqu’à ce qu’il ne reste plus personne.
fr.R: Quel malheur pour vous qui vivez le long de la mer, vous les Kéréthiens ! \q {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a parlé contre vous, Canaan, pays des Philistins : \q je te détruirai jusqu’à ce qu’il ne reste plus personne.

es.L: ¡Ay de los habitantes de la costa del mar, nación de los cereteos! \q La palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} [está] contra {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}; Canaán, tierra de los filisteos, \q te destruiré hasta que no quede habitante.
es.B: ¡Ay de {{plural_you:ustedes, los que viven|vosotros, los que vivís}} junto al mar, nación de los cereteos! \q La palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} está contra {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, Canaán, tierra de los filisteos: \q Te destruiré hasta que no quede nadie.
es.R: ¡Qué terrible será para {{plural_you:ustedes, los que viven|vosotros, los que vivís}} a la orilla del mar, cereteos! \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha hablado contra {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, Canaán, tierra de los filisteos: \q Te destruiré hasta que no quede nadie.

sw.L: Ole, wakaaji wa pwani, taifa la Wakerethi! \q Neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} liko dhidi yenu, Kanaani, nchi ya Wafilisti; \q {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitakuangamiza hata asibaki mkaaji [yeyote].
sw.B: Ole wenu ninyi mnaoishi kando ya bahari, ninyi taifa la Wakerethi! \q Neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} liko dhidi yenu, Kanaani, nchi ya Wafilisti: \q Nitakuangamiza hata asibaki mtu yeyote.
sw.R: Itakuwa vibaya sana kwenu ninyi mnaoishi kando ya bahari, ninyi Wakerethi! \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amesema dhidi yenu, Kanaani, nchi ya Wafilisti: \q Nitakuangamiza hata asibaki mtu yeyote.

vi.L: Khốn cho cư dân miền duyên hải, dân tộc Kê-rê-thít! \q Lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nghịch cùng ngươi, hỡi Ca-na-an, xứ của người Phi-li-tin; \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ hủy diệt ngươi cho đến khi không [còn] cư dân nào.
vi.B: Khốn cho các ngươi là những kẻ sống ven biển, hỡi dân tộc Kê-rê-thít! \q Lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nghịch cùng ngươi, hỡi Ca-na-an, xứ của người Phi-li-tin: \q Ta sẽ hủy diệt ngươi cho đến khi chẳng còn ai.
vi.R: Thật khốn khổ cho các ngươi là những kẻ sống dọc bờ biển, hỡi người Kê-rê-thít! \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán nghịch cùng ngươi, hỡi Ca-na-an, xứ của người Phi-li-tin: \q Ta sẽ hủy diệt ngươi cho đến khi chẳng còn ai.

ko.L: 화가 있다, 바닷가 지역의 주민들, 그렛 사람들의 민족에게! \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀이 너희를 향하고 있다. 블레셋 사람들의 땅 가나안아, \q 내가 너를 멸하여 [남는] 주민이 없게 하겠다.
ko.B: 바닷가에 사는 자들아, 그렛 민족아, 너희에게 화가 있다! \q 블레셋 사람들의 땅 가나안아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀이 너희를 향하여 내렸다. \q 내가 너를 멸하여 살아남는 사람이 하나도 없게 하겠다.
ko.R: 바닷가를 따라 사는 그렛 사람들아, 너희에게 끔찍한 일이 닥칠 것이다! \q 블레셋 사람들의 땅 가나안아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너희를 치겠다고 말씀하셨다. \q 내가 너를 멸망시켜 아무도 남지 않게 하겠다.

pt.L: Ai, habitantes da costa do mar, nação dos queretitas! \q A palavra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} [está] contra vocês, Canaã, terra dos filisteus; \q e eu te destruirei até não [restar] habitante.
pt.B: Ai de vocês que moram junto ao mar, nação dos queretitas! \q A palavra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} é contra vocês, Canaã, terra dos filisteus: \q Eu te destruirei até não sobrar ninguém.
pt.R: Que desgraça vai cair sobre vocês que moram no litoral, vocês, queretitas! \q {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} falou contra vocês, Canaã, terra dos filisteus: \q Vou te destruir até não sobrar ninguém.

am.L: ወዮ፣ በባሕሩ ዳርቻ የምትኖሩ፣ የከሪታውያን ሕዝብ! \q የፍልስጥኤማውያን ምድር ከነዓን ሆይ፣ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ቃል በእናንተ ላይ ነው፤ \q ነዋሪ እስከማይቀር ድረስ አጠፋሃለሁ።
am.B: በባሕር ዳር ለምትኖሩ፣ ለከሪታውያን ሕዝብ፣ ወዮላችሁ! \q የፍልስጥኤማውያን ምድር ከነዓን ሆይ፣ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ቃል በእናንተ ላይ ነው፤ \q አንድም ሰው እስከማይቀር ድረስ አጠፋሃለሁ።
am.R: እናንተ በባሕር ዳር የምትኖሩ ከሪታውያን፣ ወዮላችሁ! \q የፍልስጥኤማውያን ምድር ከነዓን ሆይ፣ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በእናንተ ላይ ተናግሯል፤ \q አንድም ሰው እስከማይቀር ድረስ አጠፋችኋለሁ።

hi.L: हाय, समुद्र-तट के रहनेवालो, करेती जाति! \q {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का वचन तुम्हारे विरुद्ध है, हे कनान, पलिश्तियों के देश; \q और मैं तुम्हें यहाँ तक नाश करूँगा कि कोई रहनेवाला न [बचे]।
hi.B: हाय तुम पर, जो समुद्र के किनारे रहते हो, हे करेती लोगो! \q {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का वचन तुम्हारे विरुद्ध है, हे कनान, पलिश्तियों के देश: \q मैं तुम्हें यहाँ तक नाश करूँगा कि कोई न बचे।
hi.R: तुम्हारा कितना बुरा हाल होगा, तुम जो समुद्र के किनारे रहते हो, हे करेती लोगो! \q {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने तुम्हारे विरुद्ध कहा है, हे कनान, पलिश्तियों के देश: \q मैं तुम्हें यहाँ तक नाश करूँगा कि कोई न बचे।

ru.L: Горе, жители морского побережья, народ хелефеев! \q Слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} против вас, Ханаан, земля филистимлян; \q и {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} погублю тебя, так что не [останется] жителя.
ru.B: Горе вам, живущие у моря, народ хелефеев! \q Слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} против вас, Ханаан, земля филистимлян: \q {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} погублю тебя, и никого не останется.
ru.R: Беда ждёт вас, живущих у моря, хелефеев! \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} сказал своё слово против вас, Ханаан, земля филистимлян: \q {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} погублю тебя, и никого не останется.

ja.L: ああ、災いだ、海辺の地に住む者たち、ケレティ人の国は！ \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉がおまえたちに向けられている。ペリシテ人の地、カナンよ。 \q わたしはおまえを滅ぼし、住む者がいなくなるようにする。
ja.B: ああ、災いだ、海辺に住む者たち、ケレティ人の国は！ \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉がおまえたちに臨む。ペリシテ人の地、カナンよ。 \q わたしはおまえを滅ぼし、一人も残さない。
ja.R: ああ、海辺に住むおまえたち、ケレティ人よ、おまえたちはなんとひどい目にあうことか！ \q ペリシテ人の地カナンよ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}がおまえたちに向かって語られた。 \q わたしはおまえを滅ぼし、一人も残らないようにする。

uk.L: Горе, мешканці морського узбережжя, народе керетян! \q Слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} проти вас, Ханаане, земле филистимлян; \q і {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} знищу тебе, аж не [залишиться] мешканця.
uk.B: Горе вам, хто живе біля моря, народе керетян! \q Слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} проти вас, Ханаане, земле филистимлян: \q {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} знищу тебе, аж нікого не залишиться.
uk.R: Горе вам, хто живе вздовж моря, ви, керетяни! \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} сказав проти вас, Ханаане, земле филистимлян: \q {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} знищу тебе, аж нікого не залишиться.

decisions.choice: the Cherethites: a people from Crete, part of the Philistines
decisions.reason: The Cherethites are named beside the Philistines in 1 Samuel 30:14 and Ezekiel 25:16, and David's bodyguard included Cherethites (2 Samuel 8:18). The name is generally linked with Crete, from which, with Caphtor, the Philistines came (Amos 9:7; Jeremiah 47:4). |

decisions.choice: Canaan, land of the Philistines: the coastal part of Canaan
decisions.reason: Canaan is the name of the whole land west of the Jordan. The Philistine coast was part of it (Joshua 13:3). Calling the Philistines "Canaan" may also recall that Canaan's people were to be driven out. |

decisions.choice: and I will destroy you: the LORD's own words
decisions.reason: After "the word of the LORD is against you", the LORD himself speaks. The word that is against them is the word that follows. |

decisions.choice: Woe (L), Woe to (B), How terrible it will be for (R)
decisions.reason: The cry follows the Isaiah table for hoy. Balanced and Readable put a colon before the LORD's words. |

decisions.choice: "vous" for the inhabitants, then "te" for Canaan, the land
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "you" is plural for the inhabitants and singular for Canaan ("I will destroy you"); French switches with it, as the term sheet asks.

decisions.choice: "los cereteos"
decisions.reason: The published Spanish form (Samuel, Kings, Ezekiel 25:16).

decisions.choice: plural_you, then "te"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew turns from the plural "you" (the people) to the singular (Canaan, the land); the Spanish follows it, with plural_you only on the plural.

decisions.choice: "Kê-rê-thít", as the published 1 Samuel 30:14 ("người Kê-rê-thít")
decisions.reason: The terms note's name list.

decisions.choice: The Cherethites are "그렛 사람들" (L, R) and "그렛 민족" (B)
decisions.reason: As the Korean 1 Samuel 30:14 and Ezekiel 25:16; the meaning decision explains that they came from Crete.

decisions.choice: "Ole" (L); "Ole wenu" (B); "Itakuwa vibaya sana kwenu" (R)
decisions.reason: Hoy follows the Isaiah block, here in the plural because the coast's people are addressed.

decisions.choice: Ai (L), Ai de (B), Que desgraça vai cair sobre (R); os queretitas
decisions.reason: The cry hoy keeps the Portuguese Isaiah 1:4 sets at each level. The Cherethites (m1) are "queretitas", the form 1 Samuel 30:14, 2 Samuel 8:18 and Ezekiel 25:16 use in Portuguese.

decisions.choice: vocês ... te
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "against you" in the plural to the people and then "I will destroy you" in the singular to the land of Canaan; Portuguese keeps the shift, with "vocês" for the people and God's "tu" for the land, so the words that follow are heard as the LORD's own (m3).

decisions.choice: Woe "ወዮ" (L), "ወዮላችሁ" (B, R), as Amos 5:18; Cherethites "ከሪታውያን" (2 Samuel 8:18; Ezekiel 25:16); L and B keep the Hebrew's change from 'you' plural to 'you' singular ("አጠፋሃለሁ")
decisions.reason: The prophets' woe formula and the name keep their forms on main; Readable keeps the plural throughout.

decisions.choice: हाय (L, B), कितना बुरा हाल होगा (R); करेती
decisions.reason: The cry hoy has the form settled for the Prophets: हाय at Literal and Balanced, and at Readable the wording of Luke 11:42-52 and Isaiah 10:1 (कितना बुरा हाल होगा). The Cherethites keep the form of 1 Samuel 30:14 and 2 Samuel 8:18.

decisions.choice: "Горе" (L, B); "Беда ждёт" (R)
decisions.reason: The prophets note's wording for hoy, Readable as settled while drafting Isaiah.

decisions.choice: "хелефеи"
decisions.reason: The form of 1 Samuel 30:14 and Ezekiel 25:16 in Russian for the Cherethites.

decisions.choice: hoy with a plural: "ああ、災いだ、……者たちは！" (L, B), and at R, because the English R addresses them, "……よ、おまえたちはなんとひどい目にあうことか！" (as Isaiah 33:1 R); Kerethim "ケレティ人" (1 Samuel 30:14, 1 Kings 1:38).
decisions.reason: The prophetic hoy formula (ISA-ISA-1) and the settled name form (1KI-consistency).

decisions.choice: Philistia is addressed "おまえたち" / "おまえ" at every level, the hostile-nation rule, as Joel 4:4.
decisions.reason: おまえ only for taunts and judgments against hostile nations (ISA-ISA-1).

source.text: וְֽהָיְתָ֞ה חֶ֣בֶל הַיָּ֗ם נְוֺ֛ת כְּרֹ֥ת רֹעִ֖ים וְגִדְר֥וֹת צֹֽאן׃

records.literal_gloss: And the region of the sea will become pastures, meadows of shepherds and folds of flocks.

en.L: And the seacoast will become pastures, meadows for shepherds and folds for flocks.
en.B: The land by the sea will become pastureland, with meadows for shepherds and pens for sheep.
en.R: The land by the sea will become grassland, with shepherds' camps and pens for sheep.

fr.L: Et le littoral deviendra des pâturages, des prairies pour les bergers et des enclos pour les troupeaux.
fr.B: La région côtière deviendra un pays de pâturages, avec des prairies pour les bergers et des enclos pour les moutons.
fr.R: La région au bord de la mer deviendra un pays d’herbe, avec des campements de bergers et des enclos pour les moutons.

es.L: Y la costa del mar será pastizales, praderas de pastores y corrales de rebaños.
es.B: La tierra junto al mar se convertirá en tierra de pastoreo, con praderas para los pastores y corrales para las ovejas.
es.R: La tierra junto al mar se convertirá en campo de pasto, con campamentos de pastores y corrales para las ovejas.

sw.L: Na pwani itakuwa malisho, nyanda za wachungaji na mazizi ya makundi.
sw.B: Nchi iliyo kando ya bahari itakuwa malisho, yenye nyanda za wachungaji na mazizi ya kondoo.
sw.R: Nchi iliyo kando ya bahari itakuwa nyika ya majani, yenye kambi za wachungaji na mazizi ya kondoo.

vi.L: Miền duyên hải sẽ thành đồng cỏ, bãi cho người chăn và chuồng cho bầy chiên.
vi.B: Miền đất ven biển sẽ thành đồng cỏ, có bãi cho người chăn và ràn cho chiên.
vi.R: Miền đất ven biển sẽ thành đồng cỏ, với lều trại của người chăn chiên và ràn cho chiên.

ko.L: 바닷가 지역은 목장이 되고, 목자들의 풀밭과 양 떼의 우리가 될 것이다.
ko.B: 바닷가 땅은 목초지가 되어, 목자들의 풀밭과 양 우리가 될 것이다.
ko.R: 바닷가 땅은 풀밭이 되어, 목자들이 머무는 곳과 양 우리가 될 것이다.

pt.L: E a costa do mar se tornará pastagens, prados de pastores e currais de rebanhos.
pt.B: A terra junto ao mar se tornará pastagem, com prados para os pastores e currais para as ovelhas.
pt.R: A terra junto ao mar vai virar campo de pasto, com acampamentos de pastores e currais para as ovelhas.

am.L: የባሕሩም ዳርቻ መሰማሪያዎች፣ የእረኞች ሜዳዎችና የመንጎች በረቶች ይሆናል።
am.B: በባሕር ዳር ያለው ምድር የእረኞች ሜዳዎችና የበጎች በረቶች ያሉበት መሰማሪያ ይሆናል።
am.R: በባሕር ዳር ያለው ምድር የግጦሽ ሣር ምድር ይሆናል፤ የእረኞች ሰፈርና የበጎች በረቶች ይኖሩበታል።

hi.L: और समुद्र-तट चरागाह बन जाएगा, चरवाहों के लिए घास के मैदान और भेड़-बकरियों के लिए बाड़े।
hi.B: समुद्र के किनारे का देश चरागाह बन जाएगा, जहाँ चरवाहों के लिए मैदान और भेड़ों के लिए बाड़े होंगे।
hi.R: समुद्र के किनारे का देश घास का मैदान बन जाएगा, जहाँ चरवाहों के डेरे और भेड़ों के बाड़े होंगे।

ru.L: И станет морское побережье пастбищами, лугами для пастухов и загонами для овец.
ru.B: Земля у моря станет пастбищем, с лугами для пастухов и загонами для овец.
ru.R: Земля у моря станет степью, где будут стоянки пастухов и загоны для овец.

ja.L: 海辺の地は牧草地となり、羊飼いたちの牧場、羊の群れの囲い場となる。
ja.B: 海辺の地は牧草地となり、羊飼いたちの牧場と羊の囲いがそこにできる。
ja.R: 海辺の地は草原となり、羊飼いたちの野営地や羊の囲いができる。

uk.L: І морське узбережжя стане пасовиськами, луками для пастухів і кошарами для отар.
uk.B: Земля біля моря стане пасовиськом, з луками для пастухів і загородами для овець.
uk.R: Земля біля моря стане лугом, з пастушими таборами й загородами для овець.

decisions.choice: meadows: open grazing ground, or perhaps shepherds' caves or wells
decisions.reason: The word is rare and its meaning uncertain. It may be related to the words for "dig", giving caves or wells, or to a word for a grassy field. It also sounds like the name of the Cherethites in verse 5: the land of the Cherethites becomes a land of shepherds' grounds.

decisions.choice: the crowded coast becomes grazing land
decisions.reason: The cities of the Philistines will be empty, and shepherds will graze their flocks where the towns stood. Verse 7 says whose flocks they will be. |

decisions.choice: shepherds' camps (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says "camps" for the places where shepherds stay with their flocks, leaving the uncertain word general (m1).

decisions.choice: kerot "牧場" (L, B), "野営地" (R, as the English R 'camps'); gidrot "囲い場" (L), "囲い" (B, R).
decisions.reason: kerot is uncertain (m1, footnoted).

source.text: וְהָ֣יָה חֶ֗בֶל לִשְׁאֵרִ֛ית בֵּ֥ית יְהוּדָ֖ה עֲלֵיהֶ֣ם יִרְע֑וּן בְּבָתֵּ֣י אַשְׁקְל֗וֹן בָּעֶ֨רֶב֙ יִרְבָּצ֔וּן כִּ֧י יִפְקְדֵ֛ם יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֖ם וְשָׁ֥ב שְׁבִיתָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] region will belong to [the] remnant of [the] house of Judah; on them they will graze; in [the] houses of Ashkelon in the evening they will lie down; for Yahweh their God will visit them and restore their fortunes.

en.L: And the region will be for the remnant of the house of Judah; on them they will graze; \q in the houses of Ashkelon in the evening they will lie down; \q for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God will visit them and restore their fortunes.
en.B: The coast will belong to what is left of the house of Judah; there they will pasture their flocks. \q In the evening they will lie down in the houses of Ashkelon, \q for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God will care for them and restore their fortunes.
en.R: The land by the sea will belong to the people of Judah who are left alive. They will feed their flocks there. \q In the evening they will rest in the houses of Ashkelon. \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} their God will take care of them and make things good for them again.

fr.L: Et la région sera pour le reste de la maison de Juda ; sur eux ils paîtront ; \q dans les maisons d’Ashqelôn le soir ils se coucheront ; \q car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} leur Dieu les visitera et rétablira leur sort.
fr.B: La côte appartiendra à ce qui reste de la maison de Juda ; ils y feront paître leurs troupeaux. \q Le soir, ils se coucheront dans les maisons d’Ashqelôn, \q car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} leur Dieu prendra soin d’eux et rétablira leur sort.
fr.R: La région au bord de la mer appartiendra aux gens de Juda qui seront restés en vie. Ils y feront manger leurs troupeaux. \q Le soir, ils se reposeront dans les maisons d’Ashqelôn. \q {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} leur Dieu prendra soin d’eux et les rendra de nouveau heureux.

es.L: Y la costa será para el remanente de la casa de Judá; sobre ellas apacentarán; \q en las casas de Ascalón al atardecer se acostarán; \q porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} su Dios los visitará y restaurará su suerte.
es.B: La costa será para lo que quede de la casa de Judá; allí apacentarán sus rebaños. \q Al atardecer se acostarán en las casas de Ascalón, \q porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} su Dios cuidará de ellos y restaurará su suerte.
es.R: La tierra junto al mar será de la gente de Judá que quede con vida. Allí alimentarán a sus rebaños. \q Al atardecer descansarán en las casas de Ascalón. \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} su Dios los cuidará y hará que todo vuelva a irles bien.

sw.L: Na eneo hilo litakuwa la mabaki ya nyumba ya Yuda; huko watalisha [makundi yao]; \q katika nyumba za Ashkeloni watalala jioni; \q kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao atawajia na kuwarudishia mafanikio yao.
sw.B: Pwani itakuwa mali ya mabaki ya nyumba ya Yuda; huko watalisha makundi yao. \q Jioni watalala katika nyumba za Ashkeloni, \q kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao atawatunza na kuwarudishia mafanikio yao.
sw.R: Nchi iliyo kando ya bahari itakuwa ya watu wa Yuda watakaobaki hai. Watalisha makundi yao huko. \q Jioni watapumzika katika nyumba za Ashkeloni. \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao atawatunza na kuyafanya mambo yao kuwa mema tena.

vi.L: Và miền ấy sẽ thuộc về những người sót lại của nhà Giu-đa; họ sẽ chăn bầy trên đó; \q trong các nhà của Ách-ca-lôn, chiều đến họ sẽ nằm nghỉ; \q vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của họ sẽ thăm viếng họ và phục hồi cơ đồ của họ.
vi.B: Miền ven biển sẽ thuộc về những người sót lại của nhà Giu-đa; tại đó họ sẽ chăn bầy. \q Chiều đến họ sẽ nằm nghỉ trong các nhà của Ách-ca-lôn, \q vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của họ sẽ chăm sóc họ và phục hồi cơ đồ của họ.
vi.R: Miền đất ven biển sẽ thuộc về những người Giu-đa còn sống sót. Họ sẽ chăn bầy tại đó. \q Chiều đến họ sẽ nghỉ ngơi trong các nhà của Ách-ca-lôn. \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của họ sẽ chăm sóc họ và làm cho mọi sự tốt đẹp trở lại cho họ.

ko.L: 그 지역은 유다 집의 남은 자의 것이 되고, 그들이 그곳에서 [양 떼를] 먹일 것이다. \q 저녁이면 그들이 아스글론의 집들에서 누울 것이다. \q 그들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들을 돌아보시고 그들의 운명을 돌이키실 것이기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그 바닷가 땅은 유다 집의 남은 사람들의 차지가 되어, 그들이 그곳에서 양 떼를 칠 것이다. \q 저녁이면 그들이 아스글론의 집들에서 쉴 것이다. \q 그들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들을 돌보시고 그들의 형편을 회복시키실 것이기 때문이다.
ko.R: 그 바닷가 땅은 살아남은 유다 사람들의 것이 될 것이다. 그들이 그곳에서 양 떼를 먹일 것이다. \q 저녁이 되면 그들은 아스글론의 집들에서 쉴 것이다. \q 그들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들을 돌보시고 그들을 다시 잘되게 해 주실 것이다.

pt.L: E a região será do remanescente da casa de Judá; sobre elas pastarão; \q nas casas de Asquelom, à tarde, se deitarão; \q porque {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus deles, os visitará e restaurará a sorte deles.
pt.B: A costa pertencerá ao remanescente da casa de Judá; ali eles apascentarão os seus rebanhos. \q À tarde eles se deitarão nas casas de Asquelom, \q pois {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus deles, cuidará deles e restaurará a sua sorte.
pt.R: A terra junto ao mar vai pertencer ao povo de Judá que sobreviver. Eles vão levar os seus rebanhos para pastar ali. \q À tarde vão descansar nas casas de Asquelom. \q {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus deles, vai cuidar deles e fazer a vida deles voltar a ser boa.

am.L: ያም ዳርቻ ለይሁዳ ቤት ቅሬታ ይሆናል፤ በእነርሱ ላይ ያሰማራሉ፤ \q በአስቀሎን ቤቶች በማታ ይተኛሉ፤ \q አምላካቸው {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ይጎበኛቸዋልና፤ ዕድል ፈንታቸውንም ይመልሳልና።
am.B: የባሕሩ ዳርቻ ከይሁዳ ቤት ለተረፉት ይሆናል፤ በዚያ መንጎቻቸውን ያሰማራሉ። \q በማታም በአስቀሎን ቤቶች ይተኛሉ፤ \q አምላካቸው {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ይንከባከባቸዋልና፤ ዕድል ፈንታቸውንም ይመልሳል።
am.R: በባሕር ዳር ያለው ምድር በሕይወት ለተረፉት የይሁዳ ሰዎች ይሆናል። መንጎቻቸውን በዚያ ያሰማራሉ። \q በማታም በአስቀሎን ቤቶች ያርፋሉ። \q አምላካቸው {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ይንከባከባቸዋል፤ ነገሮችንም እንደ ገና መልካም ያደርግላቸዋል።

hi.L: और वह प्रदेश यहूदा के घराने के बचे हुए लोगों का होगा; उन पर वे चराएँगे; \q अश्कलोन के घरों में वे साँझ को लेटेंगे; \q क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} उनके परमेश्वर उनकी सुधि लेंगे और उनकी दशा फेर देंगे।
hi.B: वह तट यहूदा के घराने के बचे हुए लोगों का होगा; वहाँ वे अपने झुंड चराएँगे। \q साँझ को वे अश्कलोन के घरों में लेटेंगे, \q क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} उनके परमेश्वर उनकी देखभाल करेंगे और उनकी दशा फेर देंगे।
hi.R: समुद्र के किनारे का देश यहूदा के उन लोगों का होगा जो बच गए। वे वहाँ अपने झुंड चराएँगे। \q साँझ को वे अश्कलोन के घरों में आराम करेंगे। \q {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} उनके परमेश्वर उनकी देखभाल करेंगे और उनके दिन फिर से अच्छे कर देंगे।

ru.L: И будет этот край для остатка дома Иуды; на них будут пасти; \q в домах Аскалона вечером будут ложиться; \q потому что {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, их Бог, посетит их и восстановит их благополучие.
ru.B: Побережье будет принадлежать остатку дома Иуды; там они будут пасти свои стада. \q Вечером они будут ложиться в домах Аскалона, \q потому что {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, их Бог, позаботится о них и восстановит их благополучие.
ru.R: Земля у моря будет принадлежать тем людям Иуды, которые останутся в живых. Они будут пасти там свои стада. \q Вечером они будут отдыхать в домах Аскалона. \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, их Бог, позаботится о них и снова даст им добрую жизнь.

ja.L: その地はユダの家の残りの者のものとなる。彼らはそこで[群れを]飼い、 \q 夕暮れにはアシュケロンの家々で伏す。 \q 彼らの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が彼らを顧み、彼らの繁栄を元どおりにされるからだ。
ja.B: 海辺の地は、ユダの家の残りの者のものとなる。彼らはそこで群れを飼い、 \q 夕暮れにはアシュケロンの家々で休む。 \q 彼らの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が彼らを心にかけ、その繁栄を回復してくださるからだ。
ja.R: 海辺の地は、ユダの人々のうちの生き残った者たちのものとなる。彼らはそこで羊を飼う。 \q 夕方には、アシュケロンの家々で休む。 \q 彼らの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が彼らを顧みて、再び幸せにしてくださるからだ。

uk.L: І край буде для залишку дому Юди; на них пастимуть; \q у домах Ашкелона ввечері лягатимуть; \q бо {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, їхній Бог, відвідає їх і поверне їхню долю.
uk.B: Узбережжя належатиме решті дому Юди; там вони пастимуть свої отари. \q Увечері вони лягатимуть у домах Ашкелона, \q бо {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, їхній Бог, подбає про них і поверне їм добру долю.
uk.R: Земля біля моря належатиме людям Юдеї, які залишаться живі. Вони пастимуть там свої отари. \q Увечері вони відпочиватимуть у домах Ашкелона. \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, їхній Бог, подбає про них і знову зробить їм добре.

decisions.choice: the remnant of the house of Judah: those of Judah who survive the judgment
decisions.reason: The prophets speak of a remnant who come through the judgment and receive the promises (Isaiah 10:20-22; Micah 2:12). In Zephaniah they are the humble people of 2:3 and 3:12-13. |

decisions.choice: will visit them: will come to care for them
decisions.reason: The same verb that means "punish" in 1:8-9 here means to attend to someone for good, as when God "visited" his people in Egypt (Genesis 50:24; Exodus 4:31; Ruth 1:6). |

decisions.choice: restore their fortunes: give back what they lost
decisions.reason: The phrase, "turn the turning", is used of restoring a people's former prosperity (Job 42:10; Jeremiah 30:3) and of bringing back exiles. The Hebrew text has two spellings here, one read as "captivity" and the other as "fortunes"; both senses fit a promise to a remnant.

decisions.choice: restore their fortunes (L, B); make things good for them again (R)
decisions.reason: The phrase follows the Jeremiah table. "On them" (L) refers to the pastures of verse 6; Balanced and Readable say "there". |

decisions.choice: "le reste" (L), "ce qui reste" (B), "ceux qui seront restés en vie" (R); "rétablira leur sort" (L, B), "les rendra de nouveau heureux" (R)
decisions.reason: The French prophets' settled wordings for the remnant and for restoring the fortunes.

decisions.choice: "restaurará su suerte" (L, B); "hará que todo vuelva a irles bien" (R)
decisions.reason: Restore the fortunes follows the Spanish of Jeremiah and the Psalms at each level.

decisions.choice: "mabaki" (L, B), "watakaobaki hai" (R); "kuwarudishia mafanikio" (L, B), "kuyafanya mambo yao kuwa mema tena" (R)
decisions.reason: Remnant and "restore the fortunes" as the Isaiah and Jeremiah blocks set them (Jeremiah 29:14).

decisions.choice: "phục hồi cơ đồ" (L, B) / "làm cho mọi sự tốt đẹp trở lại" (R) for "restore the fortunes"; "những người sót lại" (L, B) / "còn sống sót" (R) for the remnant
decisions.reason: The Isaiah-Jeremiah note's settled wording, as Jeremiah 29:14; Judah is "họ" in a promise.

decisions.choice: "restore their fortunes" is "운명을 돌이키다" (L), "형편을 회복시키다" (B), "다시 잘되게 해 주다" (R); the remnant is "남은 자" (L), "남은 사람들" (B), "살아남은 사람들" (R)
decisions.reason: The term sheet's wordings for both, as Isaiah and Jeremiah. Zephaniah speaks of God here, so the honorific returns.

decisions.choice: o remanescente (L, B), o povo de Judá que sobreviver (R); restaurar a sorte (L, B), fazer a vida ... voltar a ser boa (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: "o remanescente" is the prophets' word in Portuguese (m1), kept at Balanced where the English says "what is left of", so that the term is heard again in 3:13. The restoration (m3) keeps the Portuguese of Jeremiah 30:3 at each level.

decisions.choice: will visit "ይጎበኛቸዋል" (L), "ይንከባከባቸዋል" (B, R); restore their fortunes "ዕድል ፈንታቸውን ይመልሳል" (L, B), "ነገሮችን እንደ ገና መልካም ያደርግላቸዋል" (R), as Amos 9:14; the same in 3:20
decisions.reason: Here the visit is for good, so Literal keeps the Hebrew verb; the restore-fortunes formula follows Jeremiah and Amos on main.

decisions.choice: बचे हुए लोग (L, B), जो बच गए (R); दशा फेर देना (L, B), दिन फिर से अच्छे कर देना (R)
decisions.reason: The remnant has the form settled for the Prophets, and "restore their fortunes" keeps the wording of Jeremiah 29:14 at each level; the same at 3:20.

decisions.choice: "остаток" (L, B); "восстановит их благополучие" (L, B)
decisions.reason: "Остаток" is the prophets note's word for the remnant; "восстановить благополучие" is the wording of Jeremiah 29:14 and 30:3 in Russian for restoring fortunes (m3). Readable says what both mean.

decisions.choice: she'erit "残りの者" (L, B), "生き残った者たち" (R); paqad (in grace) "顧み" (L, R), "心にかけ" (B); shav shevitam "繁栄を元どおりにされる" (L), "繁栄を回復してくださる" (B), "再び幸せにしてくださる" (R), as Amos 9:14 and Joel 4:1.
decisions.reason: The prophetic remnant word and the shuv shevut formula as settled in Amos and Joel; the LORD in the prophet's words takes light respect forms.

source.text: שָׁמַ֨עְתִּי֙ חֶרְפַּ֣ת מוֹאָ֔ב וְגִדּוּפֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֑וֹן אֲשֶׁ֤ר חֵֽרְפוּ֙ אֶת־עַמִּ֔י וַיַּגְדִּ֖ילוּ עַל־גְּבוּלָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: I have heard [the] taunting of Moab and [the] revilings of [the] sons of Ammon, with which they have taunted my people and made [themselves] great against their territory.

en.L: I have heard the taunting of Moab \q and the revilings of the {{gender:children|sons}} of Ammon, \q with which they taunted {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people \q and made themselves great against their territory.
en.B: I have heard the taunts of Moab \q and the insults of the Ammonites, \q how they mocked {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people \q and made boasts against their land.
en.R: I have heard the people of Moab and Ammon \q insult and mock {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people. \q They have bragged that they would take their land.

fr.L: J’ai entendu les railleries de Moab \q et les insultes des {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Ammon, \q par lesquelles ils ont raillé {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple \q et se sont grandis contre son territoire.
fr.B: J’ai entendu les railleries de Moab \q et les insultes des Ammonites, \q leurs moqueries contre {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple \q et leurs vantardises contre son pays.
fr.R: J’ai entendu les gens de Moab et d’Ammon \q insulter {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple et se moquer de lui. \q Ils se sont vantés de prendre son pays.

es.L: He oído el insulto de Moab \q y los ultrajes de los hijos de Amón, \q con los que insultaron a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo \q y se engrandecieron contra su territorio.
es.B: He oído los insultos de Moab \q y las ofensas de los amonitas, \q cómo se burlaron de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo \q y se jactaron contra su tierra.
es.R: He oído a la gente de Moab y de Amón \q insultar y burlarse de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo. \q Se jactaron de que se quedarían con su tierra.

sw.L: Nimesikia dhihaka ya Moabu \q na matukano ya wana wa Amoni, \q ambayo kwayo waliwadhihaki watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} \q na kujikuza dhidi ya mipaka yao.
sw.B: Nimesikia dhihaka za Moabu \q na matusi ya Waamoni, \q jinsi walivyowadhihaki watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} \q na kujigamba dhidi ya nchi yao.
sw.R: Nimesikia watu wa Moabu na Amoni \q wakiwatukana na kuwadhihaki watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}. \q Wamejigamba kwamba wataichukua nchi yao.

vi.L: Ta đã nghe lời nhục mạ của Mô-áp \q và những lời lăng mạ của con cái Am-môn, \q là những lời chúng đã nhục mạ dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} \q và tự tôn mình lên nghịch cùng bờ cõi của họ.
vi.B: Ta đã nghe những lời chế nhạo của Mô-áp \q và những lời sỉ nhục của dân Am-môn, \q cách chúng đã nhạo báng dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} \q và khoác lác nghịch cùng đất đai của họ.
vi.R: Ta đã nghe dân Mô-áp và Am-môn \q sỉ nhục và chế nhạo dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. \q Chúng đã khoác lác rằng chúng sẽ chiếm lấy đất của dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.

ko.L: 나는 모압의 조롱과 \q 암몬 자손의 비방을 들었다. \q 그들이 그것으로 내 백성을 조롱하고, \q 그들의 경계를 향하여 자기들을 크게 높였다.
ko.B: 나는 모압이 퍼붓는 조롱과 \q 암몬 사람들이 내뱉는 모욕을 들었다. \q 그들은 내 백성을 비웃고, \q 그들의 땅을 두고 큰소리쳤다.
ko.R: 모압 사람들과 암몬 사람들이 \q 내 백성을 모욕하고 비웃는 소리를 내가 들었다. \q 그들은 내 백성의 땅을 빼앗겠다고 큰소리쳤다.

pt.L: Ouvi o insulto de Moabe \q e as injúrias dos filhos de Amom, \q com que insultaram o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo \q e se engrandeceram contra o território dele.
pt.B: Ouvi os insultos de Moabe \q e as ofensas dos amonitas, \q como zombaram do {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo \q e se gabaram contra a terra dele.
pt.R: Ouvi o povo de Moabe e de Amom \q insultar e zombar do {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo. \q Eles se gabaram de que iam tomar a terra dele.

am.L: የሞዓብን ስድብ \q የአሞንንም ልጆች ዘለፋ ሰምቻለሁ፤ \q በእርሱም ሕዝቤን ሰደቡ፤ \q በድንበራቸውም ላይ ራሳቸውን ከፍ ከፍ አደረጉ።
am.B: የሞዓብን ስድብ \q የአሞናውያንንም ዘለፋ ሰምቻለሁ፤ \q በሕዝቤ ላይ እንዴት እንደ ተሳለቁ፣ \q በምድራቸውም ላይ እንዴት እንደ ተመኩ ሰምቻለሁ።
am.R: የሞዓብና የአሞን ሰዎች \q ሕዝቤን ሲሰድቡና ሲያፌዙባቸው ሰምቻለሁ። \q ምድራቸውን እንወስዳለን ብለው ተመክተዋል።

hi.L: मैंने मोआब की नामधराई \q और {{gender:अम्मोन की सन्तान|अम्मोन के पुत्रों}} की निन्दा की बातें सुनी हैं, \q जिनसे उन्होंने मेरी प्रजा की नामधराई की \q और उनके देश के विरुद्ध बड़ाई मारी।
hi.B: मैंने मोआब के ताने \q और अम्मोनियों की गालियाँ सुनी हैं, \q कि उन्होंने किस तरह मेरी प्रजा का ठट्ठा किया \q और उनके देश के विरुद्ध डींगें मारीं।
hi.R: मैंने मोआब और अम्मोन के लोगों को \q मेरी प्रजा का अपमान और ठट्ठा करते सुना है। \q उन्होंने डींग मारी है कि वे उनका देश ले लेंगे।

ru.L: Я слышал поношение Моава \q и ругательства {{gender:детей Аммона|сынов Аммона}}, \q которыми они поносили {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} народ \q и величались против его пределов.
ru.B: Я слышал насмешки Моава \q и оскорбления аммонитян, \q как они издевались над {{deity_pronoun:моим|Моим}} народом \q и хвалились, что захватят его землю.
ru.R: Я слышал, как жители Моава и Аммона \q оскорбляют {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} народ и смеются над ним. \q Они хвастались, что заберут его землю.

ja.L: わたしはモアブのそしりと、 \q アンモンの子らのののしりを聞いた。 \q 彼らはそれによってわたしの民をそしり、 \q 彼らの領土に対して高ぶった。
ja.B: わたしはモアブのあざけりと、 \q アンモン人の侮辱を聞いた。 \q 彼らはわたしの民をあざけり、 \q その土地に対して大きなことを言った。
ja.R: わたしは、モアブとアンモンの人々が、 \q わたしの民を侮辱し、あざけるのを聞いた。 \q 彼らは、わたしの民の土地を奪い取ると言って、自慢した。

uk.L: Я почув глузування Моаву \q і зневаги {{gender:нащадків|синів}} Аммона, \q якими вони глузували з {{deity_pronoun:мого|Мого}} народу \q і величалися проти їхніх меж.
uk.B: Я почув глузування Моаву \q і образи аммонітян, \q як вони насміхалися з {{deity_pronoun:мого|Мого}} народу \q і хвалилися проти його землі.
uk.R: Я чув, як люди Моаву й Аммону \q ображають і висміюють {{deity_pronoun:мій|Мій}} народ. \q Вони хвалилися, що заберуть його землю.

decisions.choice: Moab and Ammon: Judah's neighbors east of the Jordan and the Dead Sea
decisions.reason: Moab and Ammon were related to Israel through Lot, Abraham's nephew (Genesis 19:36-38), but were often its enemies. The prophets condemn their cruelty and pride (Amos 1:13-2:3; Isaiah 15-16; Jeremiah 48:1-49:6; Ezekiel 25:1-11). Ezekiel 25:3, 6 says that Ammon rejoiced when the temple was ruined and Judah went into exile. |

decisions.choice: made themselves great against their territory: boasted against Judah's land, or took part of it
alternatives: enlarged their own borders at Judah's expense
decisions.reason: The verb means "make great", and with "against" it means to boast or act arrogantly against someone (Jeremiah 48:26; Ezekiel 35:13). With "their territory" it may also mean that they seized land, as Ammon did in Gilead (Amos 1:13).

decisions.choice: the children of Ammon (L, gender default), the Ammonites (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal follows Jeremiah 49:1 with the gender setting, since the people of Ammon, men and women, are meant. Balanced and Readable use the name of the people. |

decisions.choice: {{gender:enfants|fils}} d'Ammon (L); "les Ammonites" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the English and the Pentateuch's "enfants d'Israël": the people as a whole, men and women.

decisions.choice: "los hijos de Amón" with no gender span
decisions.reason: Spanish "hijos" already includes the whole people, so L has no gender span where the English has one; B and R say "los amonitas", as the English and the Spanish of Jeremiah do.

decisions.choice: "wana wa Amoni" with no gender span
decisions.reason: "Wana" covers sons and daughters, so the English gender span on "children / sons" has no Swahili counterpart.

decisions.choice: "con cái Am-môn" with no gender span
decisions.reason: "con cái" already covers sons and daughters, so the English gender span has no Vietnamese counterpart (style guide 7).

decisions.choice: "the children of Ammon" is "암몬 자손" at Literal with no gender span
decisions.reason: The style guide keeps gender spans for words Korean really says two ways; "자손" already covers sons and daughters, so the English Literal's gender span has no Korean counterpart. Balanced and Readable say "암몬 사람들", as the English "the Ammonites".

decisions.choice: os filhos de Amom (L), with no gender setting; os amonitas (B, R)
decisions.reason: As Jeremiah 49:1 has it in Portuguese, "filhos" already includes daughters, so the English gender span has no second Portuguese wording here or in verse 9. Moab and Ammon keep the forms Isaiah and Jeremiah give them.

decisions.choice: "የአሞን ልጆች" with no gender span, here and in 2:9, as Amos 1:13; "አሞናውያን" (B)
decisions.reason: "ልጆች" already means sons and daughters, so Amharic has only one wording.

decisions.choice: {{gender:अम्मोन की सन्तान|अम्मोन के पुत्रों}} (L); अम्मोनी (B), मोआब और अम्मोन के लोग (R)
decisions.reason: Literal follows Jeremiah 49:1 in this translation with the gender setting, since the people of Ammon, men and women, are meant; Balanced and Readable name the people, as the English does. The same at verse 9.

decisions.choice: {{gender:детей Аммона|сынов Аммона}} (L); "аммонитяне" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As Jeremiah 49:1 in Russian: the gender setting at Literal for the people of Ammon, men and women; Balanced and Readable name the people.

decisions.choice: bene 'Ammon "アンモンの子ら" (L), "アンモン人" (B), "アンモンの人々" (R), with no gender span: "子ら" is already inclusive (as Amos 1:13, Obadiah 12). The same for the 'their / his' span in 2:15.
decisions.reason: Style guide 7a: English gender spans become inclusive Japanese without a span.

source.text: לָכֵ֣ן חַי־אָ֡נִי נְאֻם֩ יְהוָ֨ה צְבָא֜וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל כִּֽי־מוֹאָ֞ב כִּסְדֹ֤ם תִּֽהְיֶה֙ וּבְנֵ֤י עַמּוֹן֙ כַּֽעֲמֹרָ֔ה מִמְשַׁ֥ק חָר֛וּל וּמִכְרֵה־מֶ֥לַח וּשְׁמָמָ֖ה עַד־עוֹלָ֑ם שְׁאֵרִ֤ית עַמִּי֙ יְבָזּ֔וּם וְיֶ֥תֶר גּוֹיִ֖י יִנְחָלֽוּם׃

records.literal_gloss: Therefore, [as] I live, declaration of Yahweh of hosts, God of Israel, surely Moab will be like Sodom and [the] sons of Ammon like Gomorrah, a place possessed by weeds and a pit of salt and a desolation forever; [the] remnant of my people will plunder them, and [the] rest of my nation will possess them.

en.L: Therefore, as I live, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts, the God of Israel, Moab will surely be like Sodom and the {{gender:children|sons}} of Ammon like Gomorrah, \q a place possessed by weeds, and a pit of salt, and a desolation forever; \q the remnant of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people will plunder them, \q and the rest of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} nation will possess them.
en.B: Therefore, as I live, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, the God of Israel, Moab will become like Sodom and the Ammonites like Gomorrah, \q a land overrun by weeds, a pit of salt, a wasteland forever. \q What is left of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people will plunder them; \q the survivors of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} nation will take their land.
en.R: So, as surely as I live, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, the God of Israel, Moab and Ammon will be destroyed like Sodom and Gomorrah. \q Their land will be covered with weeds and salt pits, and it will stay empty forever. \q Those of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people who are left will take their goods, \q and the survivors of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} nation will take over their land.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi, [aussi vrai que] je suis vivant, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, le Dieu d’Israël, Moab sera sûrement comme Sodome et les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Ammon comme Gomorrhe, \q un lieu livré aux orties, une fosse de sel et une désolation pour toujours ; \q le reste de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple les pillera, \q et le reste de {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} nation les possédera.
fr.B: C’est pourquoi, aussi vrai que je suis vivant, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, le Dieu d’Israël, Moab deviendra comme Sodome et les Ammonites comme Gomorrhe, \q un pays envahi par les ronces, une mine de sel, une terre dévastée pour toujours. \q Ce qui reste de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple les pillera ; \q les survivants de {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} nation prendront leur pays.
